Since my head happens to be a bit smaller than average, I figured, why not take a chance on them anyway? It's not as though I've been thrilled with the quality & wearability of the  major brands I've been wearing on more casual days (for years now!) Boy, was I surprised. reviews.t: Not too tight for my big head!
reviews.x: I’ve been blessed with a larger-than-average head and big, curly hair to top it off and these headbands aren’t too tight for me! Sure, they fit snug around your forehead but they aren’t giving me headaches and, in fact, that snugness helps keep them in place! Perfect for lounging!

10 months ago, I cut off ALL my hair, (49 3/4 inches, so A LOT) to give to a coworker whose teenage daughter had cancer and needed hair to have a wig made. I had enough hair where she wouldn't need to even ask anyone else, so yeah, I chopped it all off. That girl cares more about the way she looks, then I do, at my age. But I remember being 14...and I cared at that age what I looked like. I cared a whole bunch. But now, not so much, and since locks of love and other charities don't give wigs to

I bought this product about two years ago and am now buying it again. This isn't because they broke or have lost their elasticity, but because I have lost most of them. I am currently a nurse and was previously a CNA (nurse's aide) and wore these for basically every shift (8-12hr shifts). The colors go well with about any color of scrubs. They stay on the head pretty well for a long period of time, even with my head being a little smaller and my hair being frizzy and annoying. I also would wash

I do not wear headbands for any real athletic uses other than keeping my hair up for stretching and overall aesthetic purposes. For the price and quality, these are good! They fit a little snug which I am content with, but many may be bothered by the tightness. The only issue came along with the dark grey. The stitching was very strange and could be seen that it was messed up, it made it look like it had much more fabric and the sewing came out in a small bulge, so when put on, it sits strangely
Perfectly nice headbands in a reasonable array of neutral colors. Wide-banded. Adequately stretchy. Not much else to say about headbands, but that's the scoop. They meet expectations.

reviews.t: Does the trick for yoga workouts
reviews.x: I purchased these to keep my hair back during yoga practice. My classes are 90 minutes long and I get super sweaty but these stay put for the most part (even inversions)! Great colors and the pack is a great value.

reviews.t: No stretch and so tiny I think they were made for children
reviews.x: These things are tight. I feel like my head is getting compressed wearing them. It's disappointing because I thought they were kind of expensive and now I can't use them. The fabric they used does not have any stretch to it. They are so tiny I think they'd be comfortable on children. Adults would feel extreme discomfort just having it on and a hard time fitting it around their head. I almost couldn't make it around my head putting it on, it's about the size of my neck. I wish I'd never bought th

reviews.t: Cute headband, tighter for larger heads.
reviews.x: My sixteen year old daughter ordered these headbands, they are very cute, she wears them well, however if I wear them,  I am the mother, they fit a bit  too tight.
Way too tight for a woman's average adult size head.  Totally useless.  Not worth the hassle to return.

After reading some of these reviews, I was worried because my head is larger than average. But, they fit great and if you want them to hold in place, put some hairspray or spray gel underneath where you want it to stay. My headband never slips when I do this!

reviews.t: Nice neutral colors and material was nice - just wouldn't stay on a
reviews.x: Nice material but way too small and wouldn't stay on at all. I wish they'd put velvet on the reverse to keep it in place..

I really love these for keeping my bangs out of my face to be able to wash it. My problem with headbands is that they usually aren't tight enough for my head and fall off easily, but these fit me perfect. I did stretch one out a little bit before wearing though, definitely worth it. And i love how many you get for the price, so many single headbands cost as much as this bundle and haven't always worked as well.

Perfect for pulling my hair out of my face for my evening toilette (aka face-washing and toothbrushing).  I have a larger than normal head (men's XL hat size -- for my HUGE brain  ;-) and these are not too tight.  Plus, so inexpensive, who could argue?  No regrets buying these.
The elasticity doesn't last but one workout-I hope it comes back after washing them.

Good, snug headband for pulling your hair back when you need to work on your face; ie, washing, applying skincare and makeup. Tried to wear one all day, and though it's perfect in the short-term, it does tend to slip off slowly. I had to readjust it every couple of hours. But as I don't need to use it as a hairstyle accessory, I'm fine with the fit.

reviews.t: They would work great if my daughter would keep them on.
reviews.x: These headbands are great for my daughter who's hair isn't quite long enough to tie back yet, but still gets in her eyes. Any issues with these are more that I can't get my daughter to keep them on, more than any issue with the material or construction. Purchase without hesitation. These are exactly as advertised.

These headbands are advertised as being made from cotton. There is no tag on any of the headbands that states fabric content. And they smell really bad. They do not at all appear to be made from cotton, they do not feel like cotton, they do not smell like cotton. They are synthetic as far as I can tell.

They were a bit short and tight to use to hold bangs back-- to put the band on top of the head near the front and at the hairline at the back of the neck.  They need a bit more stretchiness.  If you want it just at the forehead and at the top of the head in back you might like them.

If these are supposed to be “ombré” why is there a pastel yellow head band instead of a khaki/tan one? Photos are misleading just for this transition color. I won’t ever wear the yellow head band, it’s not a very flattering color. The other 5 are fine, and will serve their purpose.

These headbands were for my granddaughter that is a hard one to please. She liked the way that the headbands fit by enough stretch to put on easily and the feel of the fabric.  I think next time I will get her the other colors.

reviews.t: Colours Not all As Pictured for Nuetral Pack or Black Ombré
reviews.x: I was disappointed that the two of the three colours I needed were changed to darker colours. You'll notice in my picture that the cream and the gold band were omitted entirely. Instead of those I received another shade of grey and a taupe/beige colour. I can use them but the name of the pack was nuetrals, and three of these were grey and black! -----UPDATE------  This is the second set I've bought. The first set called 'nuetral' replaced three of the six colors, and of course those missing, wer

Nice quality, but not big enough for an adult.  I have a thin face so I know my head is smaller than a lot of women's and it too small for me even when I have it behind my ears.  I wish the manufacturer would made one a little larger as it's tough finding headbands in anything besides black.

Slightly tight fit. I'm 7 1/4 hat size and these just barely are comfortable and usable. Hoping they stretch a little with use. Need headbands in sizes versus one size fits all like most seem to be made, or else material needs a little more stretch..

claims.text: Many customers find the headbands too tight or too small, especially for average or larger adult heads.
Several customers with larger-than-average heads report the headbands fit well and are not too tight.
Customers praise the headbands for staying in place during activities like yoga, workouts, and daily use.
Reviewers describe the headbands as good value, durable, and long-lasting.
A few customers report issues with elasticity not lasting or the headbands slipping off.
